Resolves #21179

Reworks `examples/grid/animatedRowSorting` into a self-updating 24-row Global Code Sprint Leaderboard so rows automatically re-sort on a 1500ms timer and glide smoothly (including the overtaking row on `dev` following #21583) without waiting for a manual header click. Removes the `maxWidth: '902px'` cap with responsive column sizing (filling desktop width and keeping `Progress` visible on mobile), adds an instruction line and keyboard-accessible Pause/Resume button, adapts the Playwright E2E suite, and updates the catalog capture recipe. No public framework API changes or migration required.

**Reduced motion (`prefers-reduced-motion`):** Changes to the `AnimateRows` plugin are out of scope per #21179, so row transitions continue to follow `--neo-duration` and the store timer starts on load when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is active. Users who prefer no motion can stop automatic updates immediately with the **Pause** button (keyboard-accessible via `Tab` + `Enter`/`Space`).

Evidence: L3 (Playwright E2E 8/8 passed, live dev-server visual captures at 1440x900 and 390x844 in both themes, and catalog cover capture via captureExamples.mjs) -> L3 required (live autonomous row movement within 5s, Pause/Resume control, adapted E2E suite, and visual captures).
